final: WITH equipment_avg AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS overall_avg FROM equipment_avg), kept AS (SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_humidity, o.overall_avg FROM equipment_avg AS e CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE e.avg_humidity > o.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS avg_kept_humidity FROM kept) SELECT k.equipref, k.avg_humidity, k.avg_humidity - k.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, k.avg_humidity - m.avg_kept_humidity AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS m WHERE k.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND m.avg_kept_humidity IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
